components.label: Metric
components.description: Single headline number or compact fact with optional trend.
components.accessibilitySummary: Headline metric and trend text are exposed as readable text.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'metric', title, accessibilityLabel, label, value, trend?: { direction: 'up'|'down'|'flat', label } }
components.selectionGuidance: Use for exact values, counts, dates, states, owners, or short facts explicitly present in the source; never estimate missing numbers.

components.label: Progress
components.description: Progress bar with numeric value and optional segment counts.
components.accessibilitySummary: Progress value is exposed with native progress semantics and text labels.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'progress', title, accessibilityLabel, value, max, label, segments?: [{ label, value }] }
components.selectionGuidance: Use only when the source provides grounded completion, quota, percentage, or count-over-total values.

components.label: Timeline
components.description: Linear dated milestones with status and optional owner.
components.accessibilitySummary: Milestones are presented as an ordered list with dates and status.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'timeline', title, accessibilityLabel, items: [{ id, label, start, end?, status: 'todo'|'active'|'blocked'|'done', owner? }] }
components.selectionGuidance: Use when chronology, milestones, deadlines, or ordered dated events are central to understanding.

components.label: Gantt
components.description: Lane-based schedule bars across a start/end date range.
components.accessibilitySummary: Schedule bars are paired with readable labels, lanes, and dates.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'gantt', title, accessibilityLabel, start, end, items: [{ id, label, start, end?, status, owner?, lane }] }
components.selectionGuidance: Use for project work distributed over time, parallel lanes, phases, or sequencing with durations.

components.label: Kanban
components.description: Column-based board of cards grouped by state or category.
components.accessibilitySummary: Cards are grouped under native section headings that remain readable without JavaScript.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'kanban', title, accessibilityLabel, columns: [{ id, title, cards: [{ id, title, meta? }] }] }
components.selectionGuidance: Use when items are best understood by status, queue, ownership bucket, or workflow state.

components.label: Priority matrix
components.description: Impact/effort or urgency/importance scatter matrix using normalized x/y positions.
components.accessibilitySummary: Items are positioned by normalized priority axes and listed in text fallback.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'priority_matrix', title, accessibilityLabel, xLabel, yLabel, items: [{ id, label, x, y, quadrant? }] }
components.selectionGuidance: Use when tradeoffs, prioritization, impact versus effort, or urgency versus importance are explicit.

components.label: Dependency graph
components.description: Nodes and directed edges showing prerequisites or unblock relationships.
components.accessibilitySummary: Graph is backed by an accessible adjacency list of dependency edges.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'dependency_graph', title, accessibilityLabel, nodes: [{ id, label, group? }], edges: [{ from, to, label? }] }
components.selectionGuidance: Use when prerequisites, blockers, ownership handoffs, or cause-and-effect relationships matter.

components.label: Flow
components.description: Ordered process steps with optional detail per step.
components.accessibilitySummary: Process is exposed as numbered flow steps with supporting details.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'flow', title, accessibilityLabel, steps: [{ id, label, detail? }] }
components.selectionGuidance: Use for procedures, decision flows, pipelines, handoff sequences, or causal step-by-step explanations.

components.label: Comparison table
components.description: Responsive matrix comparing options by columns and rows.
components.accessibilitySummary: Native table uses column and row headers for screen-reader navigation.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'comparison_table', title, accessibilityLabel, columns: [string], rows: [{ id, label, values: [string] }] }
components.selectionGuidance: Use when options, tradeoffs, alternatives, or before/after states need side-by-side comparison.

components.label: Chart
components.description: Mobile-legible SVG bar, line, area, or donut chart.
components.accessibilitySummary: SVG chart is backed by a visible data list for non-visual access.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'chart', title, accessibilityLabel, kind: 'bar'|'line'|'area'|'donut', data: [{ label, value, series? }], valueLabel? }
components.selectionGuidance: Use for explicit numeric distributions, trends, proportions, or series in the source; do not invent data.

components.label: Canvas network
components.description: Canvas-rendered static network with node coordinates and fallback list.
components.accessibilitySummary: Canvas diagram includes a static edge list fallback for accessibility.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'canvas_network', title, accessibilityLabel, nodes: [{ id, label, group?, x, y }], edges: [{ from, to, label? }] }
components.selectionGuidance: Use for dense relationship maps when approximate placement communicates clusters better than a simple list.

components.label: Three scene
components.description: React Three Fiber scene with objects in 3D space and WebGL fallback.
components.accessibilitySummary: Three-dimensional objects are described in a text fallback when WebGL is unavailable.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'three_scene', title, accessibilityLabel, objects: [{ id, label, size, position: [x, y, z] }] }
components.selectionGuidance: Use sparingly for spatial concepts, layered systems, or dimensional metaphors that benefit from 3D placement.

components.label: Details
components.description: Accessible expandable sections for lossless supporting detail.
components.accessibilitySummary: Native details sections preserve full task text and supporting evidence.
components.dataShape: { id, type: 'details', title, accessibilityLabel, sections: [{ id, title, content: [string] }] }
components.selectionGuidance: Use to preserve exact tasks, evidence, caveats, commands, or source details that would otherwise be lost.
